Laura / Tom — thanks. 10/19 15:00 PDT works for me (Ben Carter, Solutions Engineer). I've attached a one-page pre-demo checklist (pre-demo-checklist.pdf) that covers network expectations, expected payloads, and a brief runbook for the demo session. For a standard walkthrough we do not require any inbound firewall openings — we rely on HTTPS connections and token-auth for demo endpoints. If you plan to test a private model or on-prem connector, we'll need a separate connectivity plan.

Quick notes pulled from the checklist:
- We need a 5-10 minute IT intro at the start to confirm ports/proxy behavior.
- If you want to test uploads >50MB we'll need a signed S3 presigned flow; else we demo smaller payloads.
- SSO: Redwood supports SAML/OIDC; we'll ask IT for the metadata XML or OIDC well-known URL ahead of time.

Attaching: pre-demo-checklist.pdf
